spans.s:
All,Ⓒs.ⒹsarvaM, aKilaM, sAkalyaM.
Ⓔa.Ⓓsarva-viSva- pron. a., aKila, sakala, kftsna, niKila, samasta; ‘not at a(ll)’ na kimapi, na manAgapi ‘at a(ll) times’ sarvadA; ‘a(ll) but’ prAya, kalpa, in comp.; ‘a(ll) but dead’ mftaprAya; CinnaprAya ‘a(ll) but cut’; ‘a(ll) of a sudden’ akasmAt, sahasA, sapadi, ekapade; ‘this is not a(ll)’ etAvatApi dozo &c. na samApyate; ‘a(ll) I can’ yaTASakti, yaTAsAmarTyaM; ‘this is a(ll) I can do to serve you’ etAvAnme viBavo BavaMtaM sevituM (

); ‘by a(ll) means’ sarvaTA; ‘a(ll)-in-a(ll) of oneʼs life’ jIvitasarvasvaM; ‘a(ll) at once’ yugapat; ‘a(ll) round’, sarvataH, sarvadikzu, samaMtataH; ‘in a(ll)’ sAkalyena, piMqIkftya, militvA; ‘give me 20 rupees in a(ll)’ evaM piMqIkftya mahyaM viMSatiM rUpakAndehi, sarve militvA sapta vayaM ‘we are 7 in a(ll)’; ‘a(ll)- bearing’ sarvaMsaha; ‘a(ll)-conquering’ sarvadamana, sarvaMjaya, sarvaMdama; ‘a(ll)-destroying’ sarvaMkaza; ‘a(ll)-knowing’ sarvajYa, sarvavid; ‘a(ll)-pervading’ sarvavyApin, viSvAtman, sarvagata; ‘a(ll) powerful’ sarvaSaktimat.
